questions.q: Root hair cells are long and thin. How does their shape suit their job?
questions.qAf: Wortelhaarselle is lank en dun. Hoe pas hul vorm by hul taak?
options: It gives a large surface area to absorb water
It helps them carry oxygen in the blood
It helps them send electrical signals
It lets them make food by photosynthesis
optionsAf: Dit gee 'n groot oppervlakte om water te absorbeer
Dit help hulle om suurstof in die bloed te dra
Dit help hulle om elektriese seine oor te dra
Dit laat hulle voedsel deur fotosintese maak
questions.explain: Specialised cells have shapes that suit their function: root hair cells absorb water, red blood cells carry oxygen, nerve cells carry signals.
questions.explainAf: Gespesialiseerde selle het vorms wat by hul funksie pas: wortelhaarselle absorbeer water, rooibloedselle dra suurstof, senuselle dra seine oor.

questions.q: A new potato plant grows from a potato. What kind of vegetative reproduction is this?
questions.qAf: 'n Nuwe aartappelplant groei uit 'n aartappel. Watter soort vegetatiewe voortplanting is dit?
questions.explain: A potato is a tuber: a swollen underground stem that stores food. Strawberries use runners and onions are bulbs.
questions.explainAf: 'n Aartappel is 'n knol: 'n geswelde ondergrondse stingel wat voedsel stoor. Aarbeie gebruik uitlopers en uie is bolle.

questions.q: Grass and maize are pollinated by the wind. What are their flowers like?
questions.qAf: Gras en mielies word deur die wind bestuif. Hoe lyk hul blomme?
options: Small, dull petals and large feathery stigmas hanging outside
Lots of nectar to reward insects
optionsAf: Klein, dowwe blomblare en groot veeragtige stempels wat buite hang
Baie nektar om insekte te beloon
questions.explain: Wind-pollinated flowers do not need to attract insects. Their tiny light pollen blows away, and feathery stigmas catch it.
questions.explainAf: Windbestuifde blomme hoef nie insekte te lok nie. Hul klein ligte stuifmeel waai weg, en veeragtige stempels vang dit op.

questions.q: Which blood vessels carry blood away from the heart and have thick, muscular walls?
questions.qAf: Watter bloedvate dra bloed weg van die hart en het dik, gespierde wande?
questions.explain: Arteries carry blood at high pressure away from the heart. Veins have valves and carry blood back; capillaries are one cell thick.
questions.explainAf: Slagare dra bloed teen hoë druk weg van die hart. Are het kleppe en dra bloed terug; haarvate is een sel dik.

questions.q: Which waste product, from the breakdown of extra amino acids, do the kidneys remove in urine?
questions.qAf: Watter afvalproduk, van die afbraak van oortollige aminosure, verwyder die niere in urine?
questions.explain: The nephrons filter the blood and reabsorb useful substances such as glucose. Urea, extra water and salts form urine.
questions.explainAf: Die nefrone filtreer die bloed en herabsorbeer nuttige stowwe soos glukose. Ureum, oortollige water en soute vorm urine.

questions.q: Dietary fibre is not digested. Why is it still important?
questions.qAf: Dieetvesel word nie verteer nie. Waarom is dit steeds belangrik?
options: It adds bulk and keeps food moving through the gut (peristalsis)
It is the body's main source of energy
optionsAf: Dit voeg volume by en hou voedsel deur die spysverteringskanaal beweeg (peristalse)
Dit is die liggaam se hoofbron van energie
questions.explain: Fibre prevents constipation, lowers the risk of bowel cancer and slows glucose absorption.
questions.explainAf: Vesel voorkom hardlywigheid, verlaag die risiko van dermkanker en vertraag glukose-opname.

questions.q: A chlorine atom has an atomic number of 17 and a mass number of 37. How many neutrons does it have?
questions.qAf: 'n Chlooratoom het 'n atoomgetal van 17 en 'n massagetal van 37. Hoeveel neutrone het dit?
questions.explain: N = A − Z = 37 − 17 = 20. Chlorine-35 has 18, so the two are isotopes of chlorine.
questions.explainAf: N = A − Z = 37 − 17 = 20. Chloor-35 het 18, dus is die twee isotope van chloor.

questions.q: What does the octet rule say?
questions.qAf: Wat sê die oktetreël?
options: Atoms tend to react so that they get a full outer shell of 8 electrons
optionsAf: Atome reageer geneig sodat hulle 'n vol buitenste dop van 8 elektrone kry
questions.explain: Atoms lose, gain or share electrons to reach a noble gas configuration: 8 in the outer shell, or 2 for the first shell.
questions.explainAf: Atome verloor, kry of deel elektrone om 'n edelgaskonfigurasie te bereik: 8 in die buitenste dop, of 2 vir die eerste dop.

questions.q: Magnesium (2,8,2) forms an ionic bond. Which ion does it form?
questions.qAf: Magnesium (2,8,2) vorm 'n ioniese binding. Watter ioon vorm dit?
questions.explain: Magnesium loses its 2 valence electrons to reach a full shell (2,8), so it becomes Mg²⁺.
questions.explainAf: Magnesium verloor sy 2 valenselektrone om 'n vol dop (2,8) te bereik, dus word dit Mg²⁺.

questions.q: What kind of covalent bond holds the two atoms of an oxygen molecule, O₂, together?
questions.qAf: Watter soort kovalente binding hou die twee atome van 'n suurstofmolekuul, O₂, bymekaar?
options: A double bond: two shared pairs
A single bond: one shared pair
A triple bond: three shared pairs
questions.explain: O=O shares two pairs of electrons. H₂ has a single bond and N₂ a triple bond.
questions.explainAf: O=O deel twee elektronpare. H₂ het 'n enkelbinding en N₂ 'n drievoudige binding.

questions.q: How much more acidic is a solution of pH 4 than a solution of pH 5?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel meer suur is 'n oplossing met pH 4 as 'n oplossing met pH 5?
questions.explain: The pH scale is logarithmic: each step is 10 times. pH 4 is 10× more acidic than pH 5, and 100× more than pH 6.
questions.explainAf: Die pH-skaal is logaritmies: elke stap is 10 keer. pH 4 is 10× meer suur as pH 5, en 100× meer as pH 6.

questions.q: Why do farmers add lime, Ca(OH)₂, to some soils?
questions.qAf: Waarom voeg boere kalk, Ca(OH)₂, by sommige grond?
options: To neutralise acidic soil and help crops grow
To make the soil more acidic
optionsAf: Om suur grond te neutraliseer en gewasse te help groei
Om die grond suurder te maak
Om al die bakterieë dood te maak
questions.explain: Calcium hydroxide is a base. It neutralises the acid in the soil, which improves crop growth.
questions.explainAf: Kalsiumhidroksied is 'n basis. Dit neutraliseer die suur in die grond, wat gewasgroei verbeter.

questions.q: Why is incomplete combustion of methane dangerous?
questions.qAf: Waarom is onvolledige verbranding van metaan gevaarlik?
options: It makes carbon monoxide, a toxic gas
It makes no products at all
optionsAf: Dit maak glad geen produkte nie
questions.explain: With too little oxygen: 2CH₄ + 3O₂ → 2CO + 4H₂O. Complete combustion makes CO₂ and water instead.
questions.explainAf: Met te min suurstof: 2CH₄ + 3O₂ → 2CO + 4H₂O. Volledige verbranding maak eerder CO₂ en water.

questions.q: When you balance a chemical equation, what may you change?
questions.qAf: Wat mag jy verander wanneer jy 'n chemiese vergelyking balanseer?
options: Only the numbers in front of the formulas (coefficients)
The small numbers inside a formula (subscripts)
You may add atoms to one side only
optionsAf: Net die getalle voor die formules (koëffisiënte)
Jy mag net atome aan een kant byvoeg
questions.explain: Changing a subscript would make a different substance. So H₂ + O₂ → H₂O is balanced as 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.
questions.explainAf: Om 'n onderskrif te verander, sou 'n ander stof maak. H₂ + O₂ → H₂O word dus gebalanseer as 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.

questions.q: A wave spreads out after it passes through a gap. What is this called?
questions.qAf: 'n Golf versprei nadat dit deur 'n opening beweeg. Wat word dit genoem?
questions.explain: Diffraction is most noticeable when the gap is about the same size as the wavelength.
questions.explainAf: Diffraksie is die opvallendste wanneer die opening ongeveer so groot soos die golflengte is.

questions.q: A wave has a frequency of 50 Hz. What is its period? (T = 1 / f)
questions.qAf: 'n Golf het 'n frekwensie van 50 Hz. Wat is sy periode? (T = 1 / f)
questions.explain: T = 1 ÷ 50 = 0.02 s. Period and frequency are reciprocals of each other.
questions.explainAf: T = 1 ÷ 50 = 0,02 s. Periode en frekwensie is mekaar se omgekeerdes.

questions.q: Which type of electromagnetic wave causes sunburn and is used to sterilise equipment?
questions.qAf: Watter soort elektromagnetiese golf veroorsaak sonbrand en word gebruik om toerusting te steriliseer?
questions.explain: Ultraviolet (UV) causes sunburn and is used for sterilisation and to help the skin make vitamin D.
questions.explainAf: Ultraviolet (UV) veroorsaak sonbrand en word gebruik vir sterilisasie en om die vel te help om vitamien D te maak.

questions.q: What does Lenz's law say about an induced current?
questions.qAf: Wat sê Lenz se wet oor 'n geïnduseerde stroom?
options: It always flows in a direction that opposes the change that caused it
It always helps the change that caused it
It only flows in DC circuits
optionsAf: Dit vloei altyd in 'n rigting wat die verandering wat dit veroorsaak het, teëwerk
Dit help altyd die verandering wat dit veroorsaak het
questions.explain: If the induced current helped the change, you would get energy for free. Lenz's law follows from the conservation of energy.
questions.explainAf: As die geïnduseerde stroom die verandering help, sou jy energie verniet kry. Lenz se wet volg uit die behoud van energie.

questions.q: The north-seeking end of a compass needle points north. What does this tell us about Earth's geographic North Pole?
questions.qAf: Die noordsoekende punt van 'n kompasnaald wys noord. Wat sê dit vir ons oor die Aarde se geografiese Noordpool?
options: A magnetic south pole is near it
A magnetic north pole is near it
questions.explain: Unlike poles attract, so the N pole of the needle is pulled towards a magnetic south pole near the geographic North Pole.
questions.explainAf: Teenoorgestelde pole trek mekaar aan, dus word die naald se N-pool na 'n magnetiese suidpool naby die geografiese Noordpool getrek.

questions.q: What did Hans Christian Ørsted discover in 1820?
questions.qAf: Wat het Hans Christian Ørsted in 1820 ontdek?
options: An electric current creates a magnetic field around it
Magnets can be cut into single poles
optionsAf: 'n Elektriese stroom skep 'n magneetveld om hom
Magnete kan in enkel pole gesny word
questions.explain: This link between electricity and magnetism, electromagnetism, is the basis of motors, generators and transformers.
questions.explainAf: Hierdie verband tussen elektrisiteit en magnetisme, elektromagnetisme, is die basis van motors, kragopwekkers en transformators.

questions.q: Why is it so dangerous to touch a switch with wet hands?
questions.qAf: Waarom is dit so gevaarlik om 'n skakelaar met nat hande aan te raak?
options: Water with dissolved salts conducts electricity much better than dry skin
Wet hands make the switch rust immediately
It is not dangerous at all
optionsAf: Water met opgeloste soute gelei elektrisiteit baie beter as droë vel
Nat hande laat die skakelaar dadelik roes
Dit is glad nie gevaarlik nie
questions.explain: Water containing salts and minerals conducts well, so the risk of a severe or fatal shock is much higher.
questions.explainAf: Water wat soute en minerale bevat, gelei goed, dus is die risiko van 'n ernstige of dodelike skok baie hoër.

questions.q: A book lies still on a table. What can you say about the forces on it?
questions.qAf: 'n Boek lê stil op 'n tafel. Wat kan jy oor die kragte daarop sê?
options: They are balanced: its weight is balanced by the normal force from the table
There are no forces acting on it
They are unbalanced, so it accelerates
optionsAf: Hulle is gebalanseer: sy gewig word deur die normaalkrag van die tafel gebalanseer
Daar werk geen kragte daarop nie
Hulle is ongebalanseer, dus versnel dit
questions.explain: The resultant force is zero, so there is no change in motion. The normal force acts at right angles to the table's surface.
questions.explainAf: Die resulterende krag is nul, dus is daar geen verandering in beweging nie. Die normaalkrag werk loodreg op die tafel se oppervlak.

questions.q: In a tug-of-war, what is the pulling force carried along the rope called?
questions.qAf: Wat word die trekkrag wat in 'n toutrekkery langs die tou oorgedra word, genoem?
questions.explain: Tension is the pulling force transmitted through a string, rope or cable when it is pulled tight. It is a contact force.
questions.explainAf: Spankrag is die trekkrag wat deur 'n tou, lyn of kabel oorgedra word wanneer dit styf getrek word. Dit is 'n kontakkrag.

questions.q: In which layer of the atmosphere do auroras glow and the International Space Station orbit?
questions.qAf: In watter laag van die atmosfeer gloei poolligte en wentel die Internasionale Ruimtestasie?
questions.explain: The thermosphere (80–700 km) has very thin air and temperatures over 2 000 °C. Most meteors burn up lower down, in the mesosphere.
questions.explainAf: Die termosfeer (80–700 km) het baie yl lug en temperature van meer as 2 000 °C. Die meeste meteore brand laer af op, in die mesosfeer.

questions.q: Why must aeroplanes pressurise their cabins at cruising height?
questions.qAf: Waarom moet vliegtuie hul kajuite op kruishoogte onder druk plaas?
options: The air pressure is much lower, and the air is too thin to breathe
The air pressure is much higher than at sea level
There is no oxygen at all in the troposphere
optionsAf: Die lugdruk is baie laer, en die lug is te yl om asem te haal
Die lugdruk is baie hoër as by seevlak
Daar is glad geen suurstof in die troposfeer nie
Om die osoon uit te hou
questions.explain: Air pressure is the weight of the air above. Higher up there is less air above, so the pressure drops; at 12 km it is only about 20% of sea level.
questions.explainAf: Lugdruk is die gewig van die lug daarbo. Hoër op is daar minder lug daarbo, dus daal die druk; op 12 km is dit net ongeveer 20% van seevlak.

questions.q: The CO₂ level in the air has risen from about 280 ppm before industry to about 420 ppm today. By about how much has it increased?
questions.qAf: Die CO₂-vlak in die lug het gestyg van ongeveer 280 dpm voor die nywerheid tot ongeveer 420 dpm vandag. Met ongeveer hoeveel het dit toegeneem?
questions.explain: 420 − 280 = 140 ppm, and 140 ÷ 280 = 0.5, a 50% increase, driven almost entirely by human activity.
questions.explainAf: 420 − 280 = 140 dpm, en 140 ÷ 280 = 0,5, 'n toename van 50%, byna heeltemal deur menslike aktiwiteit veroorsaak.

questions.q: Which human activity adds methane (CH₄) to the atmosphere?
questions.qAf: Watter menslike aktiwiteit voeg metaan (CH₄) by die atmosfeer?
options: Farming cattle and dumping waste in landfills
optionsAf: Om beeste aan te hou en afval op stortingsterreine te stort
questions.explain: Methane comes from cattle digestion, rice paddies, waste rotting in landfills and gas leaks from pipelines.
questions.explainAf: Metaan kom van beeste se spysvertering, rysvelde, afval wat op stortingsterreine vrot en gaslekke uit pyplyne.

questions.q: What is acid mine drainage?
questions.qAf: Wat is suur mynwater?
options: Water that reacts with exposed sulfide minerals, becomes acidic and pollutes rivers
Rain that falls on a mine
Water pumped into a mine to cool it
A way of extracting gold with water
optionsAf: Water wat met blootgestelde sulfiedminerale reageer, suur word en riviere besoedel
Water wat in 'n myn gepomp word om dit af te koel
'n Manier om goud met water te ontgin
questions.explain: Acid mine drainage can pollute rivers and groundwater. It is a serious problem in parts of South Africa, such as the Witwatersrand.
questions.explainAf: Suur mynwater kan riviere en grondwater besoedel. Dit is 'n ernstige probleem in dele van Suid-Afrika, soos die Witwatersrand.

questions.q: When is open-pit (surface) mining used?
questions.qAf: Wanneer word oopgroefmynbou (oppervlakmynbou) gebruik?
options: When the mineral deposit is close to the surface
When the deposit is very deep underground
When no rock has to be moved
optionsAf: Wanneer die mineraalafsetting naby die oppervlak is
Wanneer die afsetting baie diep ondergronds is
Wanneer geen rots geskuif hoef te word nie
questions.explain: Open-pit mining is cheaper and safer but disturbs a larger area. Deep deposits need underground mining, with shafts and tunnels.
questions.explainAf: Oopgroefmynbou is goedkoper en veiliger, maar versteur 'n groter gebied. Diep afsettings het ondergrondse mynbou nodig, met skagte en tonnels.

questions.q: What happens when a protostar's core becomes hot enough (about 10 million °C)?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur wanneer 'n protoster se kern warm genoeg word (ongeveer 10 miljoen °C)?
options: Nuclear fusion starts: hydrogen fuses to form helium
optionsAf: Kernfusie begin: waterstof versmelt om helium te vorm
questions.explain: Fusion ignites and releases huge amounts of energy. Its outward pressure balances gravity, and a true star is born.
questions.explainAf: Fusie ontsteek en stel enorme hoeveelhede energie vry. Die uitwaartse druk daarvan balanseer swaartekrag, en 'n ware ster word gebore.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: The right side of the heart pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs.
questions.qAf: Die regterkant van die hart pomp suurstofarm bloed na die longe.
questions.explain: True. That is pulmonary circulation. The left side then pumps oxygenated blood to the rest of the body.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Dit is pulmonale sirkulasie. Die linkerkant pomp dan suurstofryke bloed na die res van die liggaam.

questions.q: All bases are alkalis.
questions.qAf: Alle basisse is alkalieë.
questions.explain: False. All alkalis are bases, but only bases that dissolve in water are alkalis.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Alle alkalieë is basisse, maar net basisse wat in water oplos, is alkalieë.

questions.q: Electromagnetic waves need a medium to travel through.
questions.qAf: Elektromagnetiese golwe het 'n medium nodig om deur te beweeg.
questions.explain: False. Unlike sound, EM waves can travel through a vacuum. That is how light from the Sun reaches us.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Anders as klank kan EM-golwe deur 'n vakuum beweeg. Dit is hoe lig van die Son ons bereik.

questions.q: The hole in the ozone layer and climate change are the same problem.
questions.qAf: Die gat in die osoonlaag en klimaatsverandering is dieselfde probleem.
questions.explain: False. They are separate issues. The ozone hole lets in more UV and was caused by CFCs; climate change is caused by extra greenhouse gases.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Hulle is afsonderlike kwessies. Die osoongat laat meer UV deur en is deur CFK's veroorsaak; klimaatsverandering word deur ekstra kweekhuisgasse veroorsaak.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each indicator in column A with its colour in a base (alkali) in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke indikator in kolom A by sy kleur in 'n basis (alkali) in kolom B.
questions.explain: In a base, litmus is blue, phenolphthalein pink, methyl orange yellow and universal indicator blue to violet. Phenolphthalein is colourless in acids and neutral solutions.
questions.explainAf: In 'n basis is lakmoes blou, fenolftaleïen pienk, metieloranje geel en universele indikator blou tot violet. Fenolftaleïen is kleurloos in sure en neutrale oplossings.

questions.q: Match each South African mineral in column A with where it is mainly found in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke Suid-Afrikaanse mineraal in kolom A by waar dit hoofsaaklik gevind word in kolom B.
pairs: Near Kimberley and along the West Coast
pairsAf: Naby Kimberley en langs die Weskus
questions.explain: South Africa holds most of the world's known platinum reserves. Its gold mines in the Witwatersrand are among the deepest in the world.
questions.explainAf: Suid-Afrika het die meeste van die wêreld se bekende platinumreserwes. Sy goudmyne in die Witwatersrand is van die diepstes ter wêreld.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the steps of fertilisation in a flower in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe van bevrugting in 'n blom in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: A pollen grain lands on the stigma
A pollen tube grows down through the style
The male nucleus travels down the pollen tube
The male nucleus fuses with the egg cell in the ovule
A zygote forms and develops into an embryo
stepsAf: 'n Stuifmeelbuis groei af deur die styl
Die manlike kern beweeg af in die stuifmeelbuis
Die manlike kern versmelt met die eiersel in die saadknop
'n Sigoot vorm en ontwikkel tot 'n embrio
questions.explain: Pollination comes first; fertilisation is the fusion of the male nucleus with the egg cell. The ovule then becomes the seed.
questions.explainAf: Bestuiwing kom eerste; bevrugting is die versmelting van die manlike kern met die eiersel. Die saadknop word dan die saad.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Two identical bulbs are connected in parallel across a 6 V battery. Each branch carries a current of 0.5 A.
questions.scenarioAf: Twee identiese gloeilampe word in parallel oor 'n 6 V-battery gekoppel. Elke tak dra 'n stroom van 0,5 A.

questions.q: What is the voltage across each bulb?
questions.qAf: Wat is die spanning oor elke gloeilamp?
questions.explain: In parallel, each branch gets the full supply voltage: 6 V.
questions.explainAf: In parallel kry elke tak die volle toevoerspanning: 6 V.

questions.q: What total current leaves the battery?
questions.qAf: Watter totale stroom verlaat die battery?
questions.explain: The total current is the sum of the branch currents: 0.5 + 0.5 = 1 A.
questions.explainAf: Die totale stroom is die som van die takstrome: 0,5 + 0,5 = 1 A.

questions.q: Why are the circuits in a home wired in parallel?
questions.qAf: Waarom word die stroombane in 'n huis in parallel bedraad?
options: Each appliance gets the full mains voltage and can be switched on or off by itself
It uses less wire than any other way
The current is the same everywhere
It makes all the lights go off together
optionsAf: Elke toestel kry die volle netspanning en kan op sy eie aan- of afgeskakel word
Dit gebruik minder draad as enige ander manier
Dit laat al die ligte saam afgaan
questions.explain: In parallel each branch has the same voltage and works independently, so one appliance failing does not switch off the others.
questions.explainAf: In parallel het elke tak dieselfde spanning en werk dit onafhanklik, dus skakel een toestel wat breek nie die ander af nie.
